description: Since OT/Pen only happens if the score is tied at the end of regular time, and at most 1 goal is added during OT/Pen, only Handicap lines between -1 and +1 are affected. For those, both double win and double loss scenarios are possible, depending on the exact line, the final score and the winner after OT/Pen.

cases.description: Overtime is only played on a tie, and adds at most one goal, so the winning margin never moves further than 1. A handicap of 1.5 or more therefore settles the same way at $A and at $B.
